reviewer: OpenAI Codex (automation-assisted Windows UI Automation inspection)

build.change: Native semantic-editor projection with live quest/dialogue owner, undo-history, and dirty-state routing

software.inspectionInterface: Windows UI Automation through Codex Windows application control
software.provider: Native IAccessible server attached to the SDL Win32 window through WM_GETOBJECT

procedure: Build urpg_tests, urpg_runtime, and urpg_editor together.
Launch the rebuilt editor and inspect its Windows UI Automation tree.
Enter Open Project and attempt the UIA Value route for Project folder.
Attempt a keyboard fallback to load content/examples/creator_vertical_slice and inspect live semantic rows.

semanticOwnerCoverage.liveBindings: Loaded quest and dialogue drafts are projected by the editor application and mutations commit through the existing undo/redo and dirty-state coordinators. Menu, tile-map, and world-map projection remains reusable/tested but is not yet connected to live editor document owners.

observations.nativeTreeAtLaunch: Current project, nine workspaces, creator startup commands, states, and Open Project edit/action roles were exposed.

valueOperation.diagnostic: The application-control client again rejected its UIA value read-only cache request with 0x80070057 before invoking a live value change.

projectOpenFallback.diagnostic: Individual keyboard events reached the native ImGui field, but the automation sequence retained malformed prior text and did not load the fixture; no live quest tree is claimed from this inspection.

automatedVerification.result: passed; a follow-up no-work build confirmed all three targets current

finding.improvement: Every PCQ-654 semantic owner now has one native ordered tree/list adapter for navigation, property editing, connection creation where supported, and object-linked diagnostics. Loaded quest and dialogue drafts are connected to the app bridge without bypassing undo or dirty state.
finding.remaining: Live assistive value editing, OS focus reporting, and an end-to-end loaded-project retest remain unverified. Menu, tile-map, and world-map owners still need live app binding; playtest, packaging, reopen, and signed keyboard/controller/screen-reader routes remain outstanding.
finding.retest: pending remaining live owner integration, value/focus remediation, and signed supported-screen-reader review

routeResults.note: Commands and edit/action roles are exposed; the UIA Value operation and end-to-end open remain unverified.
All five semantic owner adapters pass focused tests and quest/dialogue are live-bound, but the loaded-project UIA route was not observed and three owners remain unbound.
Object-linked diagnostics are projected by the adapter but not yet observed in a loaded native tree.
